sigma_note: The variance-law fit gave 0.02239, but sigma^2 is that fit's intercept and absorbs any error not scaling with intensity. Measured a second way from the depth of the negative tail (only additive noise can push a pixel below zero): real data dips to -0.0022 with 57% negative; 0.0224 gives -0.0269/74%, 0.0060 gives +0.0036/42%. Bracketing gives ~0.011.
